Guidance & outlook: EBITDA percentage of total income was 69.05%, also nearly 3% higher than the corresponding period of FY26.

We had taken a decision in FY26 to completely exit from the trading and marketing segment and have seamlessly recovered our dues on the 110% BG model, closing the chapter on this legacy segment in this quarter.
And we expect this trend to strengthen and continue, driving towards a healthy financial outlook for this company.
Growth & demand: 23.27 crores a growth of 22.52% and expenses has come to Rs.
61.88 crores, a growth of around 32% and PBT stands at Rs.
59.63 crores growth of again 31.70% because almost coterminous with the EBITDA part and PAT has also shown a growth of 31.14% from Rs.
Margins & costs: So, it is generally a normal increase due to increase in the salaries and wages, normal salary wages and inflationary pressure.
90 crore revenue range and 55 to 60% EBITDA margin.
And our margins have also increased and beyond 60%, like 61%-64%.
Capex & expansion: So, we have had some good run with the sale of plants all over the country.
I mean, every time it is not necessary that plants or some big-ticket sale will come up.
Balance sheet & cash: Developing a trade receivables discounting system, a treads platform has also been taken up as one of the areas showing commercial viability.
Already declared dividend, it was declared in the Quarter 4 Result, which will be subject to the approval of the shareholders in the ensuing annual general meeting.
It is the minimum dividend that a government company has to declare.
Risks & challenges: So, some kind of pressure will be on the margins also.
Regarding competition in this area is concerned, the government is more interested in credibility of the process than having multiple or going for a L1 basis.
And my last question is, given any business, if there is a higher revenue concentration to a particular geography or product or client it is always a risk.

guidance.t: So, if you can look at the highlight why we have trying to check up our income and scale up our operation but it has not much bearing on our overhead part because we have tried to check up of MSTC Limited August 14, 2026 revenue by around 22% and our total expenses has increased by 16%.

 Profit Before Tax of INR 78.63 crore in 2026-27-Q1 vis-à-vis INR 57.65 crore in 2025-26-Q1.
